envelope.description: Define strict recovery and technical-failure contracts

body.title: Define strict recovery and technical-failure contracts
body.summary: Extend design-review contracts and validators with recover/failure phases, phase versus operation discrimination, actionId/user decisions, sc3 recovery/failure state, per-unit automatic counters, bounded diagnostics, sealed unit summaries and one-fill action outcomes. Retain readable S1 checkpoints and existing size limits; declare later impact/publication seams without implementing them.
acceptanceChecks: Strict recover and failure schemas reject unknown fields, invalid discriminator/operation/identity/attempt/decision combinations and exceeded bounds before dispatch.
Typed checkpoint/progress/assignment metadata carries retry state, pointed technical feedback and completed-unit summaries without artifact-body copies or raw native transcripts.
Existing S1 checkpoint shapes remain readable; automatic initial-plus-three limits and action/attempt/unit bounds are explicit.

tests.name: Strict recover/failure schemas discriminate phase and operation and reject invalid identities, attempts, decisions, unknown fields and size limits.
Additive S1 checkpoints and bounded sc3 counters/actions/unit summaries/progress metadata round-trip without copied content or raw transcripts.
